SUBJECT:      POINT BEACH NUCLEAR PLANT, UNITS 1 AND 2; SEABROOK STATION,
              UNIT NO. 1; AND TURKEY POINT NUCLEAR GENERATING, UNIT NO 4 -
              CORRECTION OF TYPOGRAPHICAL ERRORS INCURRED DURING
              ISSUANCE OF AMENDMENT NOS. 280; 282; 181; AND 300

Dear Mr. Coffey:

On August 12, 2026 (Agencywide Documents Access and Management System (ADAMS)
Accession No. ML26209A289, the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC, the
Commission) issued the following enclosed amendments in response to the Florida Power &
Light Company, NextEra Energy Seabrook, LLC, and NextEra Energy Point Beach, LLC
application dated April 8, 2026 (ML26099A158):

       •   Amendment Nos. 280 and 282 to Renewed Facility Operating License Nos.
           DPR-24 and DPR-27 for the Point Beach Nuclear Plant, Units 1 and 2,
           respectively.

       •   Amendment No. 181 to Renewed Facility Operating License No. NPF-86 for the
           Seabrook Station, Unit No. 1

       •   Amendment No 300 to Subsequent Renewed Facility Operating License No.
           DPR-41 for the Turkey Point Nuclear Generating, Unit No. 4

The amendment revised the technical specifications (TSs) based on TS Task Force (TSTF)
Traveler TSTF-585, Revision 5, “Revise LCO [Limiting Condition for Operation] 3.0.3 to Require
Managing Risk” (TSTF-585, ML25253A379 and corrected by ML25260A487), and the
associated NRC staff safety evaluation (SE) of Traveler TSTF-585 (ML26005A205).

Recently, the Commission noticed that License Amendment Nos 280, 282, 181, and 300 had
typographical errors that did not align with the conclusions made by the Commission. These
errors include:

   1. In the enclosed amendments for the Renewed Facility Operating License Nos. DPR-24
      and DPR-27 for the Point Beach Nuclear Plant, Units 1 and 2, respectively, the
      amendment numbers were listed incorrectly. The amendments stated that the issued
      amendment numbers were 280 and 282, but they should have been 281 and 283. This
      error was repeated over the pages of the renewed facility operating licenses page 3 as
      well as the TSs.
 B. Coffey                                  -2-



   2. In the enclosed amendment for the Renewed Facility Operating License No. NPF-86 for
      the Seabrook Station, Unit No. 1, the amendment number was listed incorrectly. The
      document stated the issued amendment number as 181, but it should have been 182.
      This error was repeated over the pages of the renewed facility operating licenses page 3
      as well as the TSs.

   3. In the enclosed amendment for the Subsequent Renewed Facility Operating License No.
      DPR-41 for the Turkey Point Nuclear Generating, Unit No. 4, the amendment number
      was listed incorrectly. The document stated the issued amendment number as 300, but it
      should have been 301. This error was repeated over the pages of the renewed facility
      operating licenses page 3 as well as the TSs.

The purpose of this letter is to correct the License Amendment Nos. 280, 282, 181, and 300 to
License Amendment Nos. 281, 283, 182, and 301. The NRC concludes that these corrections
are entirely editorial in nature and do not change the staff’s previous conclusion in the SE, nor
does it affect the no significant hazards consideration, as published in the Federal Register on
May 12, 2026 (91 FR 25927). Enclosed, please find the corrections.

If you have any questions regarding this matter, please contact me at (301) 415-1721 or by
email at Theo.Edwards@nrc.gov.
